title: Geologic map of the Dale quadrangle, Beaufort and Colleton Counties, south Carolina
citation: Doar, W.R., III, 2003, Geologic map of the Dale quadrangle, Beaufort and Colleton Counties, south Carolina: South Carolina Geological Survey Geologic Quadrangle Map GQM-17, map scale 1:24,000.
notes: Coastal map, OCR; several unit symbols garbled or missing (recorded inferred with OCR text, or left out). Thicknesses printed with '|' recorded as 1, inferred. Terrace-margin elevations recorded in unit descriptions (area statements, not surfaces at a place). Cross section A-A' (vertical exaggeration 100, feet and meters scales to sea level) viewed in image tiles: no drill holes, faults or horizontal scale, so no holes, distances or contact points. No drill holes are named in the text; map-face hole numbers not recorded. No reference list.
